sources.title: Upgrading agentic coding capabilities with the new Devstral models
sources.evidence: The July 10, 2025 announcement identifies Devstral Small 1.1 and the devstral-small-2507 API ID, describes its joint development with All Hands AI, and reports 24B parameters, Apache 2.0 release and Mistral function calling support.

sources.title: Devstral Small 1.1 — model documentation and Weights table
sources.evidence: The exact v25.07 page names devstral-small-2507 and July 10, 2025. Its Weights table, present in the delivered HTML React payload, links Devstral-Small-2507 and separately reports Parameters (B): 24 and Active (B): 24. It advertises 128k context and function calling.

sources.title: Devstral Small 1.1 — pinned official model card
sources.evidence: The card names the exact 1.1 revision, credits Mistral AI and All Hands AI, states 24 billion parameters and Apache 2.0, and documents native function calling. It explicitly says this Mistral Small 3.1 fine-tune is text-only because the vision encoder was removed.

sources.title: Devstral-Small-2507 — pinned configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM configuration specifies 40 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 32768, 32 attention heads, 8 key/value heads, no sliding window, and max_position_embeddings 131072.

sources.title: Devstral-Small-2507 — pinned checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: The 363 indexed weight tensors contain 40 layers of attention projections and single gate/up/down MLP projections, plus embeddings and output head. No expert routing or vision encoder tensors appear, supporting the dense text Transformer configuration. No tensor count is converted to an exact parameter total.

sources.title: Devstral-Small-2507 — pinned system prompt
sources.evidence: The scaffold prompt encourages reflection and documenting a reasoning process during troubleshooting. It does not specify a separate native reasoning mode or thinking channel; this alone establishes neither presence nor absence of that capability.

sources.title: Devstral Small 1.1 — official Markdown model documentation
sources.evidence: The exact model page lists text input and text output, function calling, open Apache 2.0 weights and 128k context. It records deprecation on February 27, 2026 and retirement on May 31, 2026; these are historical specifications, not evidence of current API availability.

sources.title: Official checkpoint public-access probe
sources.evidence: Parent unauthenticated bounded byte-range request returned HTTP 206, Content-Range bytes 0-7/4781571736 and exactly eight bytes. Public ungated repository metadata and its ten-shard tensor index agree; no full shard was downloaded.

name.note: Use the official revision name to distinguish July 2025 from the May original and December Small 2.

developer.note: Retain the catalog provider label; the announcement and model card credit collaboration with All Hands AI.

family.note: The exact model is the July update within the Devstral family.

release_date.note: The launch announcement and exact model documentation explicitly give this date and identifier.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable checkpoint weights are published in the linked Mistral repository.

license.note: The exact July revision is explicitly released under Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Nominal whole-model count in billions, directly reported by Mistral; not an exact tensor-derived count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal active count in billions is explicitly 24 in the exact checkpoint row under Active (B). It is not inferred by equating dense active and total parameters.

architecture.note: MistralForCausalLM with 40 attention/MLP layers and one gate/up/down MLP per layer establishes a dense decoder-only Transformer; no expert routers are indexed.

context_window.note: The released checkpoint configuration specifies 131072 positions. Official API documentation advertises this as 128k; the exact checkpoint capacity is used here, without claiming a current live API limit.

modalities.note: The card explicitly says text-only and states the vision encoder was removed; official documentation lists text in and text out.

reasoning.note: The exact card, documentation and scaffold prompt do not settle a separate native reasoning mode. Ordinary prompted reflection and an omitted feature are insufficient to verify either true or false; clear the unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: The exact revision explicitly supports Mistral function calling and documents tool-call serving.

description.value: Devstral Small 1.1 is a text-only coding model developed by Mistral AI with All Hands AI for codebase exploration, file editing and software engineering agents.
description.note: Factual description limited to the documented variant, collaboration and intended use; no benchmark ranking claims.

patch.notes: The 24B total and 24B active counts are nominal values explicitly reported by Mistral. The checkpoint supports 131,072 positions; API documentation advertises 128k. Mistral documents API deprecation on 2026-02-27 and retirement on 2026-05-31. A separate native reasoning mode remains unverified.

summary: Identifies the July release as Devstral Small 1.1; adds Apache-2.0, directly disclosed nominal 24B total and 24B active counts, dense Transformer architecture and exact checkpoint context 131072. Confirms July 10 release, open weights, text-only modalities and tool calling. Native reasoning remains unverified, so baseline false is cleared. Historical API lifecycle is noted.
